answer: The proof is verified against the binary-field parameters, and the transcript is public. A farm needs 328 separate Binius proofs, since each one is bound to its own statement and witness. Binius proves over binary fields with tower arithmetic, so the proof is small and fast to verify. Watch the cedar: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the vertex bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the shale audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
